items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: Freezing out there when we played with Joe.

ctx.x: I know when we used to go in there and I didn't have enough to drink.
You know what? Out there freezing? Well, it was that night. At night we was about to die. Freezing out there when we played with Joe.
Somewhere they had a screen there. I said, this is one night I got to have something to drink. Out in the woods there somewhere.
